scientific_questions.question: Across four contiguous k1 duties, where does exact capacity pricing change from quick certification to a pricing-deadline endpoint under one matched 13,200-second budget?
For each duty, does prefix-memo reproduce the reference selector's exact certified endpoint, or improve censored progress without changing the mathematical pricing problem?

common_model.charge_model: constant station-specific power on the conservative event-time/SOC graph

resource_policy.authorization_scope: Parent approved all eight independent k1 reference/prefix diagnostics and production submission on 2026-09-14.

execution_contract.allocation_accounting: Each four-hour allocation contains one CG attempt followed by at most one short dedicated two-stage finite-pool MIP diagnostic.
execution_contract.native_record_gate: A native endpoint is admitted only after its matching worker stage returns zero and the worker/manifest/allocation/artifact bindings verify.

reporting_contract.cg_certificate: Only certified_rc_optimal=true with exact_nonnegative_reduced_cost and zero artificial weight certifies the full conservative event-time/SOC covering LP for that case.
reporting_contract.interrupted_pricing: pricing_deadline has null terminal exact reduced cost and is never a pricing certificate; the last atomically accepted pool remains usable evidence.
reporting_contract.integer_proof: The 600-second dedicated two-stage MIP is diagnostic and proves only its saved finite capacity-aware pool; fleet and charging-cost stages remain separate.
reporting_contract.physical_validation: The dedicated driver reports route feasibility by construction and audits selected charging against the continuous half-open shared-capacity sweep; this campaign does not add an independent route replay.
reporting_contract.selector_equivalence: Claim selector equivalence only for matched cases with equal exact terminal status and normalized capacity-aware routes; time-censored progress is descriptive.
reporting_contract.physics_scope: All cells use identical simplified constant-rate 240 kWh, reserve-zero, flat-price capacity physics. k1 does not expose multi-route simultaneous charger contention.
reporting_contract.terminal_target: No 65% terminal floor or target is imposed or inferred.
